scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c orange,blue "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.start:all: npm run build --workspace client && STATIC_DIR=$PWD/client/dist npm run start --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
